operating_rules: The discovery layer must be refreshed after every new container, route, capability, or runtime update.
Agent Lee should ask discovery before claiming capability.
Major tasks should go through planning governor before execution.
Runtime shells must report truthfully when provider or device wiring is not complete.
One external entrypoint is leeway_api_gateway on port 5320 when gateway wiring is active.

entrypoint.name: leeway_api_gateway
entrypoint.rule: All external requests should route through this gateway when gateway wiring is active.
